title: Rootline walkthrough: purchasing, inventory, fleet and subcontractors
description: A clickable walkthrough of the back of the house at a Columbus landscape company: a sold patio becomes a buy list and consolidated purchase orders, vendors confirm deliveries, the crew receives on site, the holding yard and bunkers are tracked, equipment is costed per hour and repaired, and a subcontractor is blocked until its insurance is current, then paid with a lien waiver.
